date_note: Date of the DonanimHaber article; the article gives no date for the claimed leak itself.
exec: A group claims to have leaked a roughly 209 GB Xbox build of GTA 6; the files are unverified and Rockstar has made no statement.
geo_basis: company headquarters (not stated in the source)
plain: A group called Cyberleek says it shared a roughly 209 GB Xbox version of GTA 6 over BitTorrent. The files have not been independently verified.
summary: DonanimHaber reports that a group called Cyberleek shared a roughly 209 GB archive it says is an Xbox build of GTA 6, distributed by BitTorrent, with the main executable withheld. The article says the files have not been verified by independent sources and Rockstar has made no official statement. It links to a VideoCardz report.
title: Cyberleek claims leak of 209 GB Xbox build of GTA 6; unverified

validation.note: One outlet (DonanimHaber, 20 Nov) read, relaying VideoCardz; VideoCardz returned HTTP 402 and was not read. No statement from Rockstar.

review.note: Checked against DonanimHaber: article only links to VideoCardz, not credits it as original source; removed malware advice not in source. Size, group, torrent, no Rockstar statement match
